purpose: User-authorized NASDAQ-100 daily versus 15-minute-informed matched experiment
dataset: Historical monthly NASDAQ-100, existing reviewed 2019-07 through 2025-12 membership
price_history: 2018-01-01 through 2025-12-31; Alpaca SIP 15Min raw bars, explicit historical ticker spellings
labels_and_accounting: Retain reviewed economic daily prices, acquisition settlements, monthly masks, and continuous cash/share accounts. Intraday bars supply additional features, not replacement return labels.
splits: Same purged annual folds as historical parent; fitting ends before prior-year validation; test fills next calendar year
feature_comparison: Both views use identically initialized 13-feature architectures. Daily control pads intraday values with missing observations and coverage zero; augmented view adds session summaries derived from all 15-minute regular-session bars. This controls parameter count; these are not exact reruns of the old five-feature fits.
session_rules: Alpaca historical exchange calendar, exact open/close including early closes; bar available only at its end. Ignore extended-hours bars. No future bars or forward-filled intraday prices.
missing_features: Keep every daily-eligible historical member. If a regular session lacks any required bar, seven intraday numeric summaries are missing; preserve observed/expected bar fraction as coverage. Training-only feature means impute missing values after standardization. Daily eligibility and labels are unchanged.
input_gate: Complete locked download, verified chunk hashes, reviewed same-security alias mapping, exact exchange calendar, no duplicate canonical bars, and at least 90% complete regular sessions across historical member/tradable days from 2019-07 onward. Disclose missing coverage by security and year. No financial test results before this gate.
losses: Existing MSE/2xHuber and StockMixer pairwise definitions; twice pseudo-Huber with delta=1 percentage point. All targets in percentage points.
early_stopping: Prior-validation MSE, selected checkpoint validation and test predictions recomputed after restoring state
device: Deterministic FP32 CUDA, no AMP or TF32, two independent worker processes
primary_portfolio: Fixed equal top-10 five-seed eligible-rank ensemble, long only; frozen orders at signal close, next-close execution; same modeled costs/liquidity as parent
inference: Paired 10000-replicate 20-session circular block intervals; 5/60-session sensitivity; 21-comparison max-statistic active-mean diagnostic family: seven augmented-minus-daily and fourteen augmented-minus-ETF contrasts. Training-seed sensitivity separate.
stop_rule: Finish all declared fits before financial test metrics. Report all models, seeds and sensitivities. No return-based K, epoch, model, feature or loss search.
limitations: 2022-2025 already inspected; this is exploratory. More intraday observations do not imply more independent market years. No trading orders or live deployment. Baseline training may run during acquisition, but augmented fits and all financial evaluation require the completed data review.
